messages:
maria_sales: Heads-up: NovaHealth wants a POC demo Tue 09:30 PT. They expect ~150 concurrent (chat+embeddings). Need Dedicated in their VPC and a short burst + higher min instances to keep warm. Can infra set this up and provide an ephemeral hosted fallback key? :stethoscope:

kevin_infra: Copy. Which pool and min/max? Peering required; do they have a network contact?

maria_sales: pool-NH-POC-02. Proposal: min_instances=8 for 1h prewarm, max_instances=40, burst.mult=4 for 2h. Demo window 2026-04-01T16:30Z-18:30Z. They will send peering details today.

lia_engineering: Note: embeddings use larger KV caches. Recommend instance_type=gpt-infer-m16 during burst and sticky-cache to avoid cold misses.

kevin_infra: Agree. I'll set instance_type override and sticky_cache=true. Also configure canary fallback to hosted key: start at 20% then escalate if 5xx spikes.

ophelia_ae: Finance, can we authorize temporary burst credits so sales can confirm?

finance-bot: action:credit.create pending \u2014 amount=USD 3500 purpose="NovaHealth POC burst" approver=ophelia_ae ts=1825001230

kevin_infra: Applying pool update (CLI):

```
rwctl dedicated update-pool \
  --pool-id pool-NH-POC-02 \
  --min-instances 8 \
  --max-instances 40 \
  --burst-multiplier 4 \
  --burst-duration 2h \
  --instance-type gpt-infer-m16 \
  --sticky-cache true \
  --prewarm 1h \
  --fallback-route hosted-api-key:proj-novahealth-temp \
  --rollback-time 2026-04-01T18:30Z
```

kevin_infra: Kicked VPC peering to NovaHealth net team. ETA 4-6h. If peering not ready we'll use a port-restricted private endpoint for the demo.

finance-bot: action:credit.approve complete \u2014 id=ch_987654 ts=1825001305 notes="NovaHealth POC"

deploy-bot: action:pool.update success \u2014 pool=pool-NH-POC-02 user=kevin_infra ts=1825001318 details="min=8 max=40 burst_multiplier=4 instance_type=gpt-infer-m16 sticky_cache=true prewarm=1h rollback=2026-04-01T18:30Z"

lia_engineering: I'll post a short runbook with rollback steps, metrics (5xx, tail latency), and failover to hosted key.

maria_sales: Great. I'll confirm with NovaHealth and share peering contact. Ping me if peering fails so we can switch to the port-restricted demo path. :white_check_mark:
